Feature Architecture

Engineered for Maximum Performance

Every component is built for speed, safety, and reliability.

🛡️

100% Anti-Cheat Friendly

Zero process injection and zero memory tampering. Vanguard, EAC, BattlEye, and Ricochet recognize it as standard native Windows display settings.

⚡

Zero Input Lag & Zero FPS Drop

Applied at the GPU hardware scan-out level via SetDeviceGammaRamp. There is zero CPU polling or shader pipeline overhead.

🎬

Cinema Fade Smooth Transitions

Smooth 12-frame hardware gamma interpolation over 150ms eliminates abrupt display flickering when switching between gaming and desktop profiles.

🔒

Protected Baseline Vault

Your factory default Windows sRGB profile is quarantined in an internal vault (.internal\), making accidental loss or corruption impossible.

📦

1-Click ZIP Migration

Export your entire library of ICC profiles, sidecar curves, slot bindings, and themes into a portable ZIP package for instant backup or laptop sync.

🎨

14 Handcrafted Themes

Personalize the application with 14 vibrant accent variants to match your Windows desktop aesthetic or battlestation RGB lighting.

FAQ Reference

Frequently Asked Questions

🛡️ Will I ever get banned in CS2, Valorant, or Apex Legends? ↓

No. You are 100% safe. Anti-cheat engines check for unauthorized DLL injection, memory writing, and DirectX hooks. Better Color Profile interacts strictly with the Windows OS display driver Look-Up Table (LUT) via official Win32 APIs. It never touches game processes.

⚡ What if an exclusive fullscreen game resets my colors on launch? ↓

A few older game engines reset the monitor gamma when grabbing fullscreen focus. Simply press your hotkey (Ctrl + Shift + C) once you are loaded into the game, and Better Color Profile instantly restores your calibrated curve.

🔄 How do I get back to standard factory monitor colors? ↓

Simply press your hotkey to cycle to Slot 1 (Default Profile), or open the sidebar and click Slot 1. This applies the pure, neutral sRGB baseline curve.
